objects.name: batch_pipeline_v
objects.description: The pipeline. One row per lot in flight or released, with its stage, stage dates, flags and lights. The facts every page of the application is built on.
objects.grain: One row per material + batch + inspection lot (row_key).

columns.name: row_key
columns.description: Key of the lot: material_no|batch_no|inspection_lot_no.

columns.name: material_no
columns.description: Material number.

columns.name: material_desc
columns.description: Material description.

columns.name: material_class
columns.description: Material class (drug substance or consumable); null when unknown.

columns.name: molecule_type
columns.description: Molecule type of the material (small molecule, large molecule, peptide).

columns.name: supplier_id
columns.description: Supplier identifier.

columns.name: supplier_name
columns.description: Supplier name.

columns.name: supplier_batch
columns.description: The supplier's own batch number.

columns.name: batch_no
columns.description: Batch number.

columns.name: batch_status_code
columns.description: ERP batch status; H means the batch is on hold.

columns.name: inspection_lot_no
columns.description: ERP inspection lot number.

columns.name: lot_type
columns.description: 01 initial receipt inspection, 09 re-evaluation (periodic retest).

columns.name: lot_start_date
columns.description: `qals.pastrterm`

columns.name: storage_location
columns.description: Current storage location of the batch.

columns.name: location_type
columns.description: Current location type (onsite or 3pl). Used for display only.

columns.name: received_location_type
columns.description: `t001l.zloctype` of `mseg.lgort` on that netted `101`. For `lot_type = '09'` it is always `onsite` (a re-evaluation cycle starts with the stock on site)

columns.name: stock_category
columns.description: From the bucket sums over all the batch's `mchb` rows: `BLOCKED` if the sum of `speme > 0`, else `QI` if the sum of `insme > 0`, else `UNRESTRICTED`

columns.name: gr_date
columns.description: `MIN(mseg.budat)` of `bwart='101'` for the batch after netting: a `102` cancels at most one `101` of the same batch, posting date and quantity, and each `101` is cancelled at most once. Unmatched or partial reversals stay as posted. `stg_mseg` is a raw copy; netting happens here

columns.name: transfer_to_site_date
columns.description: `MIN(mseg.budat)` of `bwart='311'` where `t001l(umlgo).zloctype='onsite'` and `budat ≥ gr_date`

columns.name: inbound_check_status
columns.description: `zinbchk.status` for the lot, else `'none'`

columns.name: inbound_check_completed_date
columns.description: `zinbchk.completed_on` only when the status is `passed` or `resolved` (F19); NULL for `open`, `failed` or no check (so a failed check leaves the receipt stage without an exit date)

columns.name: sample_id
columns.description: Latest LIMS sample of the lot; null when none.

columns.name: sample_collected_date
columns.description: Date the latest sample was collected.

columns.name: offsite_test
columns.description: True when the sample is tested at an external lab.

columns.name: external_lab
columns.description: The external lab, for an offsite test.

columns.name: sample_shipped_date
columns.description: Date the sample was shipped to the external lab.

columns.name: lims_status
columns.description: Latest `sample.status` for the lot: `registered`/`in_progress` → `in_progress`, `approved`, `rejected`. `'none'` if there is no sample

columns.name: lims_approved_date
columns.description: `lims_approved_at` converted to the site timezone (profile) and truncated to date

columns.name: lims_approved_at
columns.description: When LIMS approved all tests of the lot.

columns.name: ud_code
columns.description: ERP usage decision code of the lot; null until decided.

columns.name: ud_date
columns.description: Date of the usage decision.

columns.name: erp_results_recorded_at
columns.description: `qals.zresrec` for the lot (NULL if never recorded)

columns.name: campaign
columns.description: Production campaign of the earliest open demand for the material; null for a released lot.

columns.name: system_need_by_date
columns.description: Earliest open MRP requirement date on or after the snapshot date; drifts as demand moves. Null for a released lot.

columns.name: open_deviation_count
columns.description: Open deviations linked to the batch.

columns.name: closed_deviation_count
columns.description: Closed deviations linked to the batch.

columns.name: next_inspection_date
columns.description: Next inspection (retest) date of the batch, from the ERP.

columns.name: need_by_at_release
columns.description: For a released lot, the earliest requirement date on or after its cycle start (closed lines included), used for needs-by adherence.

columns.name: expedite_requested_on
columns.description: Date the ERP requested the batch be expedited.

columns.name: expedite_due_date
columns.description: Date the expedited batch is due.

columns.name: stage_key
columns.description: The stage the lot is in now (first matching rule wins).

columns.name: stage_rule_id
columns.description: The stage rule that matched, for example R-QCT (constitution P3).

columns.name: cycle_start_date
columns.description: Start of the lot's cycle: the goods receipt date, or the lot start for a re-evaluation. Null for a pending lot.

columns.name: ud_effective
columns.description: True when the usage decision is an accept code, so the lot is released.

columns.name: stage_sort
columns.description: Position of the stage in the profile order.

columns.name: current_stage_entry_date
columns.description: Entry date of the current stage; null for pending.

columns.name: lims_rejected
columns.description: True when the latest LIMS sample was rejected (a retest is expected).

columns.name: receipt_entry
columns.description: Entry date of the receipt stage.

columns.name: receipt_exit
columns.description: Exit date of the receipt stage.

columns.name: call_off_entry
columns.description: Entry date of the call-off stage (3PL lots only).

columns.name: call_off_exit
columns.description: Exit date of the call-off stage.

columns.name: sampling_entry
columns.description: Entry date of the sampling stage.

columns.name: sampling_exit
columns.description: Exit date of the sampling stage.

columns.name: qc_ship_entry
columns.description: Entry date of the external-testing shipment stage (offsite lots only).

columns.name: qc_ship_exit
columns.description: Exit date of the external-testing shipment stage.

columns.name: qc_testing_entry
columns.description: Entry date of the testing stage.

columns.name: qc_testing_exit
columns.description: Exit date of the testing stage.

columns.name: qa_release_entry
columns.description: Entry date of the QA release stage.

columns.name: qa_release_exit
columns.description: Exit date of the QA release stage.

columns.name: applicable_sla_json
columns.description: Ordered list of {stage_key, sla_days} for the stages that apply to this lot (re-evaluation SLAs included).

columns.name: source_refs_json
columns.description: The source records the row was built from (ERP, LIMS, QMS), shown by Explain.

columns.name: system_need_by_locked
columns.description: The first need-by ever seen for the lot, locked so the SLAs do not creep.

columns.name: on_hold
columns.description: The ERP hold fact (batch status H).

columns.name: erp_blocked
columns.description: True when the stock is blocked in the ERP.

columns.name: re_eval
columns.description: True for a re-evaluation lot.

columns.name: offsite
columns.description: True when the test is offsite.

columns.name: full_spec
columns.description: True when the material and supplier pair needs full-spec testing.

columns.name: ud_rejected
columns.description: True when the usage decision is a reject code.

columns.name: deviation_light
columns.description: Red when an open deviation is linked, amber when only closed ones are, green when none.

columns.name: inbound_light
columns.description: Red when the inbound check is open or failed, amber when resolved, green when passed, grey when none.

columns.name: snapshot_date
columns.description: The demo day the snapshot was taken.

columns.name: run_id
columns.description: The pipeline run that published the row. A mixed run id across objects means a publish was interrupted.

columns.name: published_at
columns.description: When the run published, on the demo clock.

objects.name: weekly_metrics_v
objects.description: On-time performance of each pipeline-computed metric, by ISO week (the last 52 complete weeks plus the current week to date).
objects.grain: One row per metric and week; weeks with no completions are present with 0 completed.

columns.name: metric_id
columns.description: Metric identifier (M1 to M7).

columns.name: week_start
columns.description: Monday that starts the ISO week, in the site time zone.

columns.name: completed
columns.description: Lots whose exit date for the metric's stage falls in the period.

columns.name: on_time
columns.description: Completed lots that took no longer than their SLA for the stage.

columns.name: pct
columns.description: On-time share of the completed lots, one decimal; null when nothing completed.

columns.name: run_id
columns.description: The pipeline run that published the row. A mixed run id across objects means a publish was interrupted.

objects.name: weekly_metric_rows_v
objects.description: The lots behind every weekly metric figure, so a number can be explained row by row.
objects.grain: One row per metric, week and lot.

columns.name: metric_id
columns.description: Metric identifier (M1 to M7).

columns.name: week_start
columns.description: Monday that starts the ISO week, in the site time zone.

columns.name: row_key
columns.description: Key of the lot: material_no|batch_no|inspection_lot_no.

columns.name: entry_date
columns.description: Entry date of the metric's stage for the lot.

columns.name: exit_date
columns.description: Exit date of the metric's stage for the lot.

columns.name: duration_days
columns.description: Days from entry to exit.

columns.name: sla_days
columns.description: The lot's own SLA for the stage (re-evaluation aware).

columns.name: on_time
columns.description: True when the lot completed within its SLA.

columns.name: run_id
columns.description: The pipeline run that published the row. A mixed run id across objects means a publish was interrupted.

objects.name: stage_reference_v
objects.description: The stages of the site profile in order, with their SLA, owning team and the action that moves a lot on.

columns.name: stage_key

columns.name: label
columns.description: Display label.

columns.name: sort
columns.description: Position of the stage in the profile order.

columns.name: sla_days
columns.description: SLA of the stage in days.

columns.name: reeval_sla_days
columns.description: SLA of the stage for a re-evaluation lot, where it differs.

columns.name: team
columns.description: Owning team.

columns.name: action
columns.description: What has to happen to move a lot out of the stage.

columns.name: terminal
columns.description: True for the final stage (released).

columns.name: show_card
columns.description: Whether the stage has a card on the Overview.

objects.name: metric_reference_v

columns.name: computed_in

columns.name: status
columns.description: active, or awaiting_signal when the input arrives later.

columns.name: null_reason

objects.name: reason_codes_v

columns.name: code

objects.name: pipeline_runs_v
objects.description: The history of pipeline runs (the last 100), including runs that failed since the previous publication. Behind the Sync Status page.

columns.name: pipeline_run_id
columns.description: Id of the pipeline run the row describes (the Dagster run id).

columns.name: run_seq
columns.description: Wall-clock microseconds when the run was logged; orders the runs, because the demo clock does not tick.

columns.name: started_at
columns.description: When it started, on the demo clock.

columns.name: duration_ms
columns.description: Real elapsed time in milliseconds (the demo clock does not tick, so it cannot be derived from the timestamps).

columns.name: files
columns.description: Source tables extracted by the run; null when extract failed.

columns.name: inserted
columns.description: Rows that are new or whose content hash changed since the previous successful run; null for a failed run.

columns.name: total
columns.description: Rows in the published pipeline after the run; null for a failed run.

columns.name: skipped
columns.description: Rows unchanged since the previous successful run (total minus inserted); null for a failed run.

columns.name: status
columns.description: ok or failed.

columns.name: failed_step
columns.description: The step that failed; null for an ok run.

columns.name: run_id
columns.description: The run that published this history (not the run described by the row).

objects.name: pipeline_run_steps_v

objects.grain: One row per run and step.

columns.name: pipeline_run_id
columns.description: Id of the run the step belongs to.

columns.name: step
columns.description: setup, extract, transform, snapshot_aggregate, publish or notify.

columns.name: status
columns.description: success or failed.

columns.name: started_at
columns.description: When it started, on the demo clock.

columns.name: finished_at
columns.description: When it finished, on the demo clock.

columns.name: duration_ms
columns.description: Real elapsed time in milliseconds (the demo clock does not tick, so it cannot be derived from the timestamps).

columns.name: rows
columns.description: Rows the step produced.

columns.name: error
columns.description: Error text; null when there was none.

columns.name: run_id
columns.description: The run that published this history.

objects.name: pipeline_status_v

columns.name: last_run_id
columns.description: Id of the last successful run (the Dagster run id).

columns.name: started_at
columns.description: When it started, on the demo clock.

columns.name: last_success_at
columns.description: When the last successful run published, on the demo clock.

columns.name: row_count
columns.description: Rows in the published pipeline.

columns.name: source_freshness_json
